title_ru: Осирис — терракотовый фаллический корпус: полный текущий музейный проход и метрология
scope_note: 33 directly audited Egyptian terracotta phallic/ithyphallic museum records were resolved in the current official-digital-catalog pass. Additional museum-cited accession leads are queued; the artifact does not claim exhaustiveness over every surviving object worldwide.

major_results.detail: Museum catalogues explicitly identify same/similar mould series, multiple variants, and a production waster. Serial phallic figurine production is therefore a real workshop phenomenon.
Separate insert phallus, hollow inserted stump, and empty phallus sockets occur in the audited terracotta corpus.

major_results.warning: BM uses thickness while Louvre uses width of a high-relief fragment. Axis semantics are not yet homologous; no same-mould claim is admitted.

major_results.detail: British Museum Naukratis Project catalogues these as the same mould series.
Catalogued as very similar but not from the same mould.
